content.text: Co-sleeping at 5 is really common, and kids his age usually do well with a gradual move. Tonight, start with the bedtime routine in his own room, with a short, predictable end. Tell him the plan ahead of time, like "I'll read two books, give you a hug, then you sleep in your bed." Then stay by his bed until he's drowsy, and move your chair a little farther away every few nights.
